cohort: 632 pregnant women from Istanbul, Turkey, between January 2020 to August 2022,  267 with confirmed COVID-19 and 365 without
finding: While there were no significant differences in cesarean delivery rates or most neonatal outcomes between pregnant women with and without COVID-19, neonates born to mothers with COVID-19 in the second trimester had decreased birth height.
birth_weight: Neonates born to mothers with COVID-19 in the second trimester had decreased birth height.
